Rooted in the Arabic word 'bitanah', meaning 'gift' or 'grant', the name signifies Allah's ever-abiding blessings and provisions to His creations. It is a reminder of the boundless mercy and generosity of Allah, as He bestows upon mankind His infinite gifts, including emaan (faith), wisdom, and daily sustenance. By carrying this name, individuals are encouraged to cultivate a strong spiritual practice, seeking to emulate the generosity and kindness of their Creator in their daily lives.
